title: Sharp half-linear local-inverse dual limit on equicorrelations
statement: For positive equicorrelation with rho=c/n, fixed c>0, and local-inverse bandwidth q/n tending to 1/2, the dual certificate has transverse limit one and parallel limit at least one half. The latter is sharp as c tends to infinity. Any q=o(n) in the same feature family has parallel limit (1+c)/(1+c+c^2/3), below one half for c>(3+sqrt(21))/2.
assumptions: Positive equicorrelation scaling rho=c/n with fixed c
Local triangular inverse truncated to bandwidth q
Limit n to infinity with q/n tending to one half or zero
open_objections: The theorem concerns a structured scaling limit, not finite arbitrary SPD matrices.
No Lean formalization, priority audit, or outside-human validation exists.
